decisions.reason: Selecting the stainless-steel whisk does not change the existing smoothness, consistency, or frothiness acceptance criteria.
The whisk selection does not alter the existing splash-control target or conditional mitigation measures.
The selected whisk is compatible with the established bowl context but does not change bowl capacity, depth, or refill policy.
The whisk-head material decision does not change the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication method.
No enclosure size or proportion constraint is changed by accepting the proposed whisk.
The stainless-steel whisk selection does not modify the machine's DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source decision does not affect the placard text, position, or viewing orientation.
The whisk material is a component selection and does not change the machine's beige and green color scheme.
Accepting the whisk does not change any dispensing-flow, anti-drip, or beverage-preservation requirement.
The whisk-head selection does not necessarily change the required wiring-plan detail level or electrical layout deliverable.
The whisk decision does not affect whether the custom spout must be removable for cleaning.
The selected whisk does not change the requirement for easy bowl removal and rapid swapping.
